messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Eval gate trip detected for 'safety/violation-rate' on model redwood-7b-v2 in prod-us-west-2. Threshold exceeded (configured: 0.5%, observed: 3.2%). 1200 failing eval samples in the last 5m. PagerDuty page created: PD-INC-8243.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty notification: Incident PD-INC-8243 — severity: P1 — triggered. Escalation policy: "Evaluation Gate". Paging on-call: dave_oncall.

dave_oncall: Ack'd. I'm on it. Can someone confirm customer-visible impact?

carla_pm: Seeing a couple of direct reports in support queue about unsafe outputs in completions (account ids redacted). No outage but increased trust & safety tickets. Flagged two customers requesting rollback.

ben_ml: Quick summary from eval infra: the regression shows a safety regression after the rolling canary (redwood-7b-v2) deployed ~03:10 UTC. Failure modes: toxic content score > threshold, and hallucination rate spike on a set of curated prompts. Reproduced locally against canary snapshot.

maria_sre: Thanks. Any telemetry on traffic fraction for canary?

ben_ml: Canary traffic ~7% across us-west-2. Most failing samples routed to canary as they match the prompt fingerprint set.

carla_pm: Customers are not fully blocked but trust is degraded. We should treat as P1 for T&S impact and customer trust, coordinate a rollback.

ben_ml: Agreed. Proposal: immediate rollback of routing to previous model variant (redwood-7b-v1.9-stable) for prod-us-west-2 and pause further canary promotions. Also trigger full eval sweep for v2 offline.

maria_sre: I'll prepare the routing override. dave_oncall, want me to apply and then handoff to infra to verify?

Dave_oncall: Yes. Apply override and post the commands you run. I'll coordinate comms and keep PagerDuty updated.

maria_sre: Running override now.

maria_sre: ```
# route override to pin model to v1.9 in us-west-2
rctl set-route --cluster prod-us-west-2 --service inference --model redwood-7b-v1.9-stable --weight 100 --reason "eval-gate rollback due to safety regression"
```

maria_sre: Override applied. Verifying rollout...

ben_ml: Kicking off a quick smoke eval on the live traffic sample against v1.9 to ensure rates fall back.

support_bot: Support: Notified affected customers with templated message: "We're investigating increased unsafe outputs and have temporarily reverted a recent model change. We'll follow up with details and timelines."

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-8243 acknowledged by dave_oncall at 1789456200.

maria_sre: Metrics: safety violation rate in prod-us-west-2 peaked at 3.2% (5m window), now down to 0.6% 4m after override. Token processing and latency within normal bounds.

ben_ml: Running an offline eval sweep against the failing prompt set and human review queue. Will share a diff report. If v2 has an unsafe policy edge-case, we need to mark it and block re-promote until fixed.

carla_pm: Good. I'll draft a short incident note for customers and legal/t&s. Need ETA for root cause and next update in 1 hour.

dave_oncall: Setting incident status: mitigated -> partial mitigation (routing rollback). Still investigating root cause. Owner: ben_ml (root cause + fix), maria_sre (routing + infra verification), dave_oncall (incident lead/comm).

ben_ml: Early hypothesis: small tokenizer change in v2 altered parsing of user-supplied markup causing prompts to bypass safety filters in a subset. Repro steps in my local eval repo.

maria_sre: I'll keep watch on metrics and back out override if anything unexpected. Also creating a short runbook snippet:

maria_sre: ```
# quick verify commands
rctl status --cluster prod-us-west-2 --service inference | grep redwood-7b
curl -s https://telemetry.internal/metrics?safety_violation_rate=1m | jq '.rates["prod-us-west-2"]'
```

support_bot: Logged incident PD-INC-8243 in triage board and created ticket SUPPORT-4021 for customer callbacks.

ben_ml: Shared diff report link: https://internal/reports/eval-diffs/PD-INC-8243 (will redact customer ids). Initial human review shows 94% of the failing set are symptomatic of the tokenizer edge-case.

carla_pm: Requesting an internal post to #customer-success so CSMs can proactively reach out to affected customers.

maria_sre: Monitoring looks stable. Still seeing a tiny tail but within expected noise (0.2%-0.8%).

ben_ml: Next steps: (1) patch tokenizer handling in v2 branch, (2) run exhaustive safety eval, (3) prepare a canary plan with blocking evals, (4) only re-promote once we verify zero regression on the curated set. ETA for patch + internal PR: ~3 hours.

carla_pm: OK. Provide an update in 1 hour. I'll coordinate customer comms and legal as needed.

dave_oncall: PD-INC-8243 status: Mitigated -> monitoring. Keeping the page open until patch lands and is validated. If metrics stay stable for 60m, we'll move to resolved with follow-up report.

maria_sre: Noting handoff: I will be on-call for the next 30m then hand to oncall+1 (jen_oncall). Posting runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/eval-rollback.md

ben_ml: Quick note for postmortem: include gating tests we lacked (tokenizer regression tests) and consider adding a pre-promotion safety sweep enforced by CI.

dave_oncall: Thanks all. If anything spikes, re-page me or escalate PD-INC-8243. Closing simple comms loop here.

maria_sre: Metrics stable at last check. I'll update if anything changes.

ben_ml: PR opened: github.com/redwood/ml/compare/v2-tokenizer-fix (WIP). Tagging reviewers.

carla_pm: Thanks. I'll post a short customer update in 30m.

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-8243: status changed to monitoring at 1789457160.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived to incidents channel. Remember to file RFC and postmortem once resolved. :white_check_mark:
